references.phrase: open subset U of topological space
references.context: Topology: membership in the topology on X

references.phrase: closure(U) is open for every open U
references.disposition: The universal quantifier is over all open subsets; it does not say every subset has open closure.

review_rationale: Reviewed requirement that closure of every open U of X is open in X; do not mistake this for total disconnectedness or the weaker property that closures of closed sets remain closed.
